senses.gloss: (abbr. of אִית, as לי = לית) there is. Y. Snh. VI, 23ᵇ bot. אי בי וכ׳ there is in me (the possibility of) doing, i.e. I can do it.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>מה אי וכ׳</he> what is it thou canst do? (v.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:2:6">Y. Ḥag. II, 78ᵃ</cite> top).
